name: Berja (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally by a broad white stripe from the upper hoist to the lower fly, green above and magenta below.
history: Berja adopted its arms officially on 22 September 2004 and its flag on 20 January 2000; the flag is divided diagonally by a white stripe a quarter of the width of the cloth running from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly corner.

features.role: broad white diagonal stripe one quarter of the width
